module: Editor "Resources Checker" window (Assets menu) to audit the current level's resources. Three tabs: "Materials Verification" (material version, duplicates, pid removal, PNG conversion, verification of texture maps/files, missing or dummy materials), "Resources Explorer" (loaded TSStatics, ForestItems, terrains, used or unused materials/meshes/textures, collision data) and "Asset Stats" (file scan, treemap and list by size). Also allows image preview, resolving duplicates and deleting unused files. The heavy computations are done by resourceUtil (extensions.editor_resourceChecker_resourceUtil) which returns its results through jobData.
notes: resourceUtil is read at file initialization (extensions.editor_resourceChecker_resourceUtil): it is nil if that extension is not already loaded at that moment.
jobData(type, data): type 2 stores the material checker result, type 3 that of the resources explorer; the other types are ignored.
Some actions of this panel delete level files ("Remove selected files", "Remove all unused files"): use with caution.

jobData.desc: Receives the result of an asynchronous resourceUtil job and stores it for display.

type.desc: 2 = material verification results, 3 = resources explorer results.

updateDuplicateTable.desc: Replaces the duplicates table displayed in the duplicate resolver.

data.desc: Duplicates table computed by resourceUtil (inferred from code).

onWindowMenuItem.desc: Shows the "resourceChecker" window (called by the menu entry).

onEditorGui.desc: Hook: draws the tabbed window, the image preview and the duplicate resolver.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook: adds the "Resources Checker" menu entry (Assets group) and registers the three windows (main, image preview, duplicates).
